Ovarian_Hibernation_V1_to_V9_CTRPv2_PRIS.note: Contains CTRPv2, PRISM_secondary, and PRISM_primary_only drug matrices for Ovarian DepMap models (n=45-63). Pan-cancer raw PRISM/CTRPv2 parquets are not cached locally on disk; GDSC1 + GDSC2 parquets cover pan-cancer CNS/GBM, NSCLC, Breast, and Melanoma lines.

staged_matrices_on_disk.Cilengitide_Screen_Status: Cilengitide is NOT present in GDSC1 (378 drugs), GDSC2 (286 drugs), or the cached CTRPv2/PRISM compound tables. Direct target engagement is measured via ITGAV, ITGB3, ITGB5, PTK2 (FAK1), and FERMT2 CRISPR Chronos knockout across all 1,186 lines, plus direct pharmacologic inhibition of its downstream integrin kinases FAK1/2 (GSK2256098C in GDSC2; PF-562271 in GDSC1) and SRC/Ephrin (Dasatinib, Bosutinib, Saracatinib in GDSC1/2).

key_findings: 1. In NSCLC (n=95), ZEB1 expression strongly predicts ITGAV (rho = -0.624, p = 1.48e-11; Tertile ΔChronos = -0.734, MWU p = 2.05e-8; Quartile Q75-vs-Q25 Δ = -0.765, p = 1.47e-7), ITGB5 (rho = -0.482, p = 7.4e-7, Tertile Δ = -0.488), FERMT2 (rho = -0.444, p = 6.5e-6, Tertile Δ = -0.420), and PTK2/FAK1 (rho = -0.441, p = 7.6e-6, Tertile Δ = -0.279), whereas ITGB3 is weak (rho = -0.186, p = 0.0712), proving αVβ5 (ITGAV+ITGB5) -> FAK1/Kindlin-2 is the primary NSCLC dependency.

2. In CNS_Glioblastoma (n=45), single-gene ZEB1 mRNA does NOT stratify ITGAV (rho = +0.085, p = 0.5806, Tertile Δ = +0.036) because GBM lines are constitutively ITGAV-dependent (mean Chronos = -0.91) and ZEB1 acts as a neural/proneural factor that correlates with CHEK1 (rho = -0.523, p = 0.0002) and intracellular focal-adhesion adapters FERMT2 (rho = -0.418, p = 0.0043, Tertile Δ = -0.568) and PTK2/FAK1 (rho = -0.303, p = 0.0434, Tertile Δ = -0.354).

3. Replacing single-gene ZEB1 with our locked Two-Door S_sen / H_clean or 4-gene Mesenchymal score rescues integrin/focal-adhesion stratification in CNS/Glioblastoma (n=45) and CNS/Brain (n=80): in GBM (n=45), S_sen significantly predicts BCL2L1 (rho = -0.590, p = 1.9e-5, Tertile Δ = -0.532), FERMT2 (rho = -0.433, p = 0.0030, Tertile Δ = -0.478), ITGB5 (rho = -0.366, p = 0.0135, Tertile Δ = -0.360), PTK2 (rho = -0.349, p = 0.0189), and ITGAV (rho = -0.342, p = 0.0217, Tertile Δ = -0.364, MWU p = 0.0128).

4. PTK2 (FAK1) is the ONLY universal ZEB1/Mesenchymal CRISPR dependency across all 4 brain-tropic solid tumor lineages: GBM (H_clean rho = -0.409, p = 0.0052; ZEB1 rho = -0.303, p = 0.0434), NSCLC (ZEB1 rho = -0.441, p = 7.6e-6), Breast (Mesenchymal_4 rho = -0.574, p = 2.4e-5; ZEB1 rho = -0.484, p = 0.0006), and Melanoma (Mesenchymal_4 rho = -0.369, p = 0.0023; ZEB1 rho = -0.245, p = 0.0470).

5. In GDSC2 pharmacology, ZEB1/Mesenchymal/S_sen-high models across GBM, NSCLC, Breast, and Melanoma are significantly SENSITIVE to Dasatinib (GBM ZEB1 rho_LN_IC50 = -0.439, p = 0.0362, ΔLN_IC50 = -2.312 [10.1x]; Breast Mes_4 rho = -0.573, p = 4.6e-5, Δ = -2.277 [9.7x]; Melanoma Mes_4 rho = -0.439, p = 0.0084; NSCLC ZEB1 rho = -0.236, p = 0.0252), FAK1 inhibitor GSK2256098C in GBM (ZEB1 rho = -0.474, MWU p = 0.0411, Δ = -1.024), dual mTORC1/2 & CNS PI3K/mTOR inhibitors in GBM/Glioma (AZD2014 rho = -0.779, p = 0.0004; AZD8055 rho = -0.732, p = 0.0013; GNE-317 rho = -0.556, p = 0.0012), and BCL-xL inhibitors in Breast (Navitoclax rho = -0.377, p = 0.0108; ABT-737 rho = -0.346, p = 0.0214; WEHI-539 rho = -0.323, p = 0.0344), while S_sen-high models are universally RESISTANT to Door-1 drugs (Temozolomide, AZD6738, VE-822, MK-1775, AZD7762, Niraparib, Talazoparib).
